identity_checks: B1 equals original OOF at atol=1e-14
O4.limitation: Cache has no historical P checksum in S1; current NPZ SHA256 is recorded.

ordering: Descending numeric score, ascending lexical pair_id on ties; exactly k rows.
inclusion_convention: ORL accepts SCORE >= step cutoff; comparator uses SCORE < cutoff. Service global lower bound uses SCORE >= minimum PAR=2 SCORE, including all ties (2522). Exact top-k breaks ties by pair_id, so k_min_36 may be smaller than 2522.

assumptions.perfect_reviewer: All top-k PAR=2 accepted and all top-k nonlinks rejected: comparator FP=0. Nonlinks reviewed are workload, NOT false positives; P_fp are observed automatic false positives.
assumptions.human_error_05: Sensitivity scenario only: (211 + 0.95 * PAR2_topk)/247. The 211 ORL links remain fixed; no 5% false-positive rate is assumed for nonlinks.
assumptions.P_recovery: Accepted + referred PAR=2, assuming perfect review of referrals; P 5% scenario discounts referrals only, not automatic acceptances.
assumptions.K2: Human + LLM review counts of P, not time-equivalent or cost-equivalent workloads.

verification_bias: Os PAR=2 foram definidos pela revisao do servico, que se presume em ordem de SCORE. O1 e favorecido por construcao. O3/O4 sao comparadores mais justos com o GZ-CMD. Nao e uma estimativa independente de sensibilidade nem uma analise registrada.
